rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamic loading of Cobalt Strike beacons via rundll32 from Temp directories"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $dll_path = /\\AppData\\[\\w]+\\Temp\\[\\w\\.]+\.dll$/ wide ascii
        $rundll_cmd = "rundll32.exe" wide ascii
    condition:
        $rundll_cmd and $dll_path
}
